document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function() {
  const loading = document.getElementById('__bundler_loading');
  function setStatus(msg) { if (loading) loading.textContent = msg; }

  const FONT_MIME = /^(font[/]|application[/](x-)?font-|application[/]vnd\.ms-fontobject)/i;
  const MIME_TOKEN = /^[\w.+-]+[/][\w.+-]+$/;

        e.target.tagName, String(e.target.src || e.target.href || ''));

    var d = document.getElementById('__bundler_err') || p.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));
    d.id = '__bundler_err';
    d.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:12px;left:12px;right:12px;font:12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;background:#2a1215;color:#ff8a80;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #5c2b2e;z-index:99999;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:40vh;overflow:auto';

      '[bundle] ' + (e.message || e.type) +
      (e.filename ? ' (' + e.filename.slice(0, 60) + ':' + e.lineno + ')' : '');

    const manifestEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/manifest"]');
    const templateEl = document.querySelector('script[type="__bundler/template"]');
    if (!manifestEl || !templateEl) {
      setStatus('Error: missing bundle data');
      console.error('[bundler] Missing script tags — manifestEl:', !!manifestEl, 'templateEl:', !!templateEl);
      return;
    }

    const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestEl.textContent);
    let template = JSON.parse(templateEl.textContent);

    // document's manifest; frame srcs carry an about:blank#<uuid> marker
    // instead of a substitutable uuid. Every document mints the blobs for
    // its OWN frames — from local text at the root, or text obtained from
    // its DIRECT parent over the relay protocol below — so each frame
    // navigation stays same-origin with its initiator and a deduped page
    // loads at any depth on any host, including a file:// download's
    // opaque origins (where a blob minted by one document cannot be
    // navigated to by another).

    const pageOrder = pageOrderEl ? JSON.parse(pageOrderEl.textContent) : [];
    const pageSet = new Set(pageOrder);
    const pageTexts = {};

    // Page bundles ship once, in the ROOT document's manifest. Every
    // document mints the blobs for its OWN frames, obtaining page text
    // through a strict parent-chain relay: a document only ever SENDS to
    // its direct parent (which, for every document the publisher's own
    // runtime minted, is another publisher document) and only ACCEPTS
    // text from that direct parent; requests from below are honored only
    // for the document's own child frames, and the ROOT never sends
    // upward at all. That last rule is load-bearing: the artifact host's
    // frame-ancestors allows claude.ai (and friends) to frame an
    // artifact, so window.top can be a FOREIGN document — a top-addressed
    // protocol would hand page uuids to that ancestor and accept forged
    // "page text" from it, minting attacker HTML as an artifact-origin
    // blob document. The chain never touches the ancestor: requests stop
    // at the root, replies are origin-addressed per hop (never '*' when
    // an origin exists), and both directions are origin-gated (on https
    // a foreign sender's origin can never equal this document's; in
    // opaque contexts — file:// — everything serializes as 'null', where
    // an embedded EXTERNAL frame still fails the gate by carrying its
    // own real origin, and a sandboxed child of such a frame is excluded
    // by the own-child-frames check plus uuid unguessability). Shape is
    // deny-by-default: one request form, one reply form, no error
    // replies.
    // window.origin is the SERIALIZED SECURITY origin ('null' in opaque
    // contexts such as a sandboxed preview iframe) — location.origin is
    // computed from the URL and stays 'https://…' even when the document
    // is sandboxed, which would misgate every opaque chain.
    const OWN_TARGET = /^https?:[/][/]/.test(window.origin || '')
      ? window.origin
      : '*';
    function trustedOrigin(e) {
      if (e.origin === window.origin) return true; // https chains; opaque==opaque

      // 'file://' while the blob: documents it mints serialize as 'null',
      // so the two legitimate shapes can never string-match — accept the
      // pair in both directions. https origins never serialize as either,
      // and sender identity (own child frame / direct parent) is checked
      // separately.
      return (
        (e.origin === 'null' &&
          (window.origin === 'file://' ||
            window.location.protocol === 'file:')) ||
        (/^file:/.test(e.origin) && window.origin === 'null')

    // Non-empty only in the root document (nested bundles ship an empty
    // island), so it doubles as the root marker: the root answers from
    // local text and treats a miss as authoritative — never relaying to
    // its (possibly foreign) parent.
    const isPageRoot = pageOrder.length > 0;
    const blobUrls = {};
    const resourceBlobs = {};
    const UUID_SHAPE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
    const pendingFrames = {}; // uuid -> [{el, frag}] awaiting text for own frames
    const pendingRelays = {}; // uuid -> [childWindow] awaiting text to pass down
    function mountPage(el, frag, text) {
      const pageBlob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/html' });
      const u = URL.createObjectURL(pageBlob);
      resourceBlobs[u] = pageBlob;
      el.src = u + frag;
    }
    function deliverPage(uuid, text) {
      const frames = pendingFrames[uuid];
      delete pendingFrames[uuid];
      if (frames) for (const f of frames) mountPage(f.el, f.frag, text);
      const relays = pendingRelays[uuid];
      delete pendingRelays[uuid];
      if (relays) {
        for (const cw of relays) {
          try { cw.postMessage({ __bundler_page: uuid, __bundler_text: text }, OWN_TARGET); } catch (err) { /* gone */ }
        }
      }
    }
    function ownFrameWindows() {
      const out = [];
      for (const f of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe'))) {
        try { if (f.contentWindow) out.push(f.contentWindow); } catch (err) { /* detached */ }
      }
      return out;
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
      const d = e.data;
      if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || !e.source) return;
      // Origin gate first; the structural checks below (own-child-frames
      // for requests, direct-parent + solicited-uuid for replies, the
      // root's never-relay rule) are what hold in fully opaque chains
      // where origin strings can't discriminate — a sandboxed root's
      // FOREIGN wrapper still fails all three even though both serialize
      // as real-vs-'null' rather than matching.
      if (!trustedOrigin(e)) return;

        // Requests are honored only for this document's own child frames.
        if (ownFrameWindows().indexOf(e.source) < 0) return;
        const uuid = d.__bundler_need;

          try { e.source.postMessage({ __bundler_page: uuid, __bundler_text: text }, OWN_TARGET); } catch (err) { /* gone */ }

        UUID_SHAPE.test(d.__bundler_page) &&

        // check below uses the in operator, which matches prototype keys

    // degraded state as a refused embed.

      // does XHR against the src, but blob:null/ from a file:// origin is
      // silently dropped. Inlining makes it a plain inline babel script,
      // which transformScriptTags handles unconditionally.

    setStatus('Error unpacking: ' + err.message);
    console.error('Bundle unpack error:', err);
  }

a:hover{color:#8C2B0B}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<\u002Fhelmet>\n\n\n\n<div style=\"min-height:100vh;background:#F1EADC;font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;color:#14181F;padding:34px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px\">\n\n  <div style=\"display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;max-width:820px\">\n    <div style=\"font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:#8C7F6C\">WEPROMPT · BEAT PANEL · SHOT COMPOSER STATES<\u002Fdiv>\n    <div style=\"font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.015em\">Every state the shot card can be in<\u002Fdiv>\n    <div style=\"font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:#4A5262;text-wrap:pretty\">One card per state, in the order a director meets them. The card never changes shape — only its status word, its slots, the tag beside the button, and the button itself.<\u002Fdiv>\n  <\u002Fdiv>\n\n  <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(430px,1fr));gap:18px\">\n    <sc-for list=\"{{ cards }}\" as=\"c\" hint-placeholder-count=\"8\">\n      <div style=\"display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px\">\n\n        <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:9px\">\n          <span style=\"font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:#B4380F\">{{ c.num }}<\u002Fspan>\n          <span style=\"font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em\">{{ c.title }}<\u002Fspan>\n        <\u002Fdiv>\n\n        <div style=\"{{ c.card }}\">\n          <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px\">\n            <span style=\"{{ c.onBadge }}\">ON<\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;flex:none\">{{ c.shot }}<\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"flex:1;min-width:0;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:0.09em;color:#8C7F6C\">{{ c.chain }}<\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"{{ c.statusStyle }}\">{{ c.status }}<\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:#8C7F6C;cursor:pointer;flex:none\">⋯<\u002Fspan>\n          <\u002Fdiv>\n\n          <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid #EFE7D8\">\n            <span style=\"font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:0.09em;color:#8C7F6C\">{{ c.framesNote }}<\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"flex:1\"><\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#6E6553;border:1px solid #CBD0D8;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 9px;cursor:pointer\" style-hover=\"background:#F1EADC\">Import<\u002Fspan>\n          <\u002Fdiv>\n\n          <div style=\"display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px\">\n            <sc-for list=\"{{ c.slots }}\" as=\"s\" hint-placeholder-count=\"3\">\n              <div style=\"{{ s.shell }}\">\n                <span style=\"{{ s.emptyBox }}\">\n                  <span style=\"font-size:12px;line-height:1\">▣<\u002Fspan>\n                  <span style=\"font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:0.09em;white-space:nowrap\">{{ s.label }}<\u002Fspan>\n                <\u002Fspan>\n                <span style=\"{{ s.badge }}\">{{ s.badgeText }}<\u002Fspan>\n              <\u002Fdiv>\n            <\u002Fsc-for>\n          <\u002Fdiv>\n\n          <div style=\"{{ c.promptBox }}\">{{ c.prompt }}<\u002Fdiv>\n\n          <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px\">\n            <span style=\"{{ c.tag }}\">{{ c.tagText }}<\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"flex:1\"><\u002Fspan>\n            <span style=\"{{ c.btn }}\">{{ c.btnLabel }}<\u002Fspan>\n          <\u002Fdiv>\n\n          <div style=\"{{ c.footBox }}\">{{ c.foot }}<\u002Fdiv>\n        <\u002Fdiv>\n\n        <div style=\"font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;color:#6E6553;text-wrap:pretty\">{{ c.rule }}<\u002Fdiv>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fsc-for>\n  <\u002Fdiv>\n\n  <div style=\"display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #E4D9C6\">\n    <span style=\"font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:0.11em;color:#8C7F6C\">RULES ACROSS THE SET<\u002Fspan>\n  <\u002Fdiv>\n\n  <div style=\"display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap\">\n    <sc-for list=\"{{ notes }}\" as=\"n\" hint-placeholder-count=\"4\">\n      <div style=\"flex:1;min-width:260px;background:#FBF7F0;border:1px solid #E4D9C6;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px\">\n        <div style=\"font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:0.09em;color:#B4380F\">{{ n.tag }}<\u002Fdiv>\n        <div style=\"font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#2A303B\">{{ n.body }}<\u002Fdiv>\n      <\u002Fdiv>\n    <\u002Fsc-for>\n  <\u002Fdiv>\n\n<\u002Fdiv>\n<\u002Fx-dc>\n<script type=\"text/x-dc\" data-dc-script=\"\" data-props=\"{&quot;$preview&quot;:{&quot;width&quot;:1000,&quot;height&quot;:700}}\">\nclass Component extends DCLogic {\n  slot(kind, img, label, badgeText, lit) {\n    const filled = !!img;\n    return {\n      label: label, badgeText: badgeText,\n      shell: 'position:relative;display:block;height:66px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;'\n        + (filled ? 'background:#14181F url(' + img + ') center/cover no-repeat;' : 'background:#F1EADC;')\n        + 'border:' + (lit ? '2px solid #C9431A' : '1px solid #E4D9C6'),\n      emptyBox: 'position:absolute;inset:0;display:' + (filled ? 'none' : 'flex') + ';flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;color:#6E6553',\n      badge: 'position:absolute;left:5px;bottom:5px;font-family:\\'IBM Plex Mono\\',monospace;font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:0.09em;white-space:nowrap;color:#FFF6EF;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 5px;'\n        + 'background:' + (lit ? '#C9431A' : 'rgba(20,24,31,0.72)') + ';'\n        + 'display:' + (badgeText ? 'block' : 'none')\n    };\n  }\n\n  build(c) {\n    const card = 'background:#FBF7F0;border:1px solid #E4D9C6;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;'\n      + 'border-left:3px solid ' + (c.on ? '#C9431A' : '#E4D9C6') + ';'\n      + (c.dim ? 'opacity:0.9;' : '');\n    const btnKind = {\n      primary: 'color:#FFFFFF;background:#C9431A;border:1px solid #C9431A;cursor:pointer',\n      quiet: 'color:#A79C89;background:#F1EADC;border:1px solid #E4D9C6;cursor:not-allowed',\n      cancel: 'color:#8C2B0B;background:#FDF0E9;border:1px solid #F0C6B0;cursor:pointer',\n      outline: 'color:#6E6553;background:transparent;border:1px solid #CBD0D8;cursor:pointer'\n    }[c.btnKind];\n    return {\n      num: c.num, title: c.title, shot: c.shot, chain: c.chain, status: c.status,\n      framesNote: c.framesNote, prompt: c.prompt, rule: c.rule, foot: c.foot,\n      btnLabel: c.btnLabel, tagText: c.tagText, slots: c.slots, card: card,\n      onBadge: 'font-family:\\'IBM Plex Mono\\',monospace;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:0.09em;color:#FFF6EF;background:#C9431A;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 6px;flex:none;'\n        + 'display:' + (c.on ? 'inline-block' : 'none'),\n      statusStyle: 'font-family:\\'IBM Plex Mono\\',monospace;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:0.09em;white-space:nowrap;flex:none;color:' + c.statusTint,\n      promptBox: 'font-family:\\'Source Sans 3\\',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 10px;min-height:38px;box-sizing:border-box;'\n        + (c.promptEmpty ? 'color:#A79C89;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px dashed #E4D9C6' : 'color:#2A303B;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #E4D9C6'),\n      tag: 'font-family:\\'IBM Plex Mono\\',monospace;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:0.09em;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 6px;'\n        + (c.tagTint === 'warn' ? 'color:#8A6A18;background:#FBF2DA;border:1px solid #E8D7A8;'\n          : c.tagTint === 'bad' ? 'color:#8C2B0B;background:#FDF0E9;border:1px solid #F0C6B0;'\n          : 'color:#B4380F;background:#FDF0E9;border:1px solid #F0C6B0;')\n        + 'display:' + (c.tagText ? 'inline-block' : 'none'),\n      btn: 'font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;white-space:nowrap;' + btnKind,\n      footBox: 'font-family:\\'IBM Plex Mono\\',monospace;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:0.08em;line-height:1.5;color:' + (c.footTint || '#8C7F6C') + ';'\n        + 'display:' + (c.foot ? 'block' : 'none')\n    };\n  }\n\n  renderVals() {\n    const A = './assets/shot-01.png', B = './assets/shot-03.png', C = './assets/shot-04.png';\n    const empty = [this.slot('start', null, 'START', '', false), this.slot('end', null, 'END', '', false), this.slot('refs', null, 'REFS', '', false)];\n    const startOnly = [this.slot('start', A, 'START', 'START FRAME', true), this.slot('end', null, 'END', '', false), this.slot('refs', null, 'REFS', '', false)];\n    const full = [this.slot('start', A, 'START', 'START FRAME', true), this.slot('end', C, 'END', 'END FRAME', false), this.slot('refs', B, 'REFS', 'REFS 2', false)];\n    const p = 'Cook works the steamer baskets as the street lights come up behind her.';\n\n    const set = [\n      { num: '01', title: 'Not ready', shot: 'Shot 1', on: true, chain: 'HEAD OF THE CHAIN · NOTHING RUNS BEFORE IT',\n        status: 'NOT READY', statusTint: '#8A6A18', framesNote: 'FRAMES · NONE SET', slots: empty,\n        prompt: 'Describe this shot, or reference a frame with @…', promptEmpty: true,\n        tagText: '', btnLabel: 'Generate Shot 1', btnKind: 'quiet',\n        foot: 'A START FRAME IS REQUIRED BEFORE THE SHOT CAN RUN',\n        rule: 'Empty slots, empty prompt. Generate is present but inert, and the card says what is missing rather than hiding the button.' },\n\n      { num: '02', title: 'Ready to render', shot: 'Shot 1', on: true, chain: 'HEAD OF THE CHAIN · NOTHING RUNS BEFORE IT',\n        status: 'READY TO RENDER', statusTint: '#6E6553', framesNote: 'FRAMES · 1 SET', slots: startOnly,\n        prompt: p, tagText: '', btnLabel: 'Generate Shot 1', btnKind: 'primary',\n        foot: '', rule: 'A start frame and words are enough. End frame and refs stay optional — nothing nags for them.' },\n\n      { num: '03', title: 'All three slots filled', shot: 'Shot 2', on: false, chain: 'CONTINUES FROM SHOT 1’S LAST FRAME',\n        status: 'READY TO RENDER', statusTint: '#6E6553', framesNote: 'FRAMES · 3 SET', slots: full,\n        prompt: 'Hold on the steam, then she turns towards the street.', tagText: '', btnLabel: 'Generate Shot 2', btnKind: 'primary',\n        foot: 'END FRAME SET · THE SHOT HAS TO LAND ON THAT PICTURE',\n        rule: 'An end frame narrows the shot to a landing point; refs steer look only. Both are inputs, never outputs.' },\n\n      { num: '04', title: 'Rendering', shot: 'Shot 1', on: true, chain: 'HEAD OF THE CHAIN · NOTHING RUNS BEFORE IT',\n        status: 'RENDERING · 40%', statusTint: '#2A5FA8', framesNote: 'FRAMES · 1 SET', slots: startOnly,\n        prompt: p, tagText: '', btnLabel: 'Cancel run', btnKind: 'cancel',\n        foot: 'RUNNING WITH THE PROMPT AS FIRED · EDITS APPLY NEXT RUN',\n        rule: 'The prompt stays editable while the run is in flight, but the run keeps the words it was fired with.' },\n\n      { num: '05', title: 'Rendered', shot: 'Shot 1', on: true, chain: 'HEAD OF THE CHAIN · NOTHING RUNS BEFORE IT',\n        status: 'RENDERED', statusTint: '#2E7D5B', framesNote: 'FRAMES · 1 SET', slots: startOnly,\n        prompt: p, tagText: '', btnLabel: 'Regenerate', btnKind: 'outline',\n        foot: 'ITS LAST FRAME IS NOW SHOT 2’S START FRAME',\n        rule: 'Done is quiet. The primary weight moves off this card, and the handover to the next shot is stated once.' },\n\n      { num: '06', title: 'Edited after a run', shot: 'Shot 1', on: true, chain: 'HEAD OF THE CHAIN · NOTHING RUNS BEFORE IT',\n        status: 'RENDERED', statusTint: '#2E7D5B', framesNote: 'FRAMES · 1 SET', slots: startOnly,\n        prompt: 'Cook works the steamer baskets, rain starting on the awning behind her.', tagText: 'EDITED · NOT YET RUN', tagTint: 'accent',\n        btnLabel: 'Regenerate', btnKind: 'primary', foot: '',\n        rule: 'The picture on screen no longer matches the words. The tag says so and the button takes back the primary weight.' },\n\n      { num: '07', title: 'Queued in a chain', shot: 'Shot 2', on: false, chain: 'CONTINUES FROM SHOT 1’S LAST FRAME',\n        status: 'QUEUED', statusTint: '#2A5FA8', framesNote: 'FRAMES · WAITING ON SHOT 1', slots: empty,\n        prompt: 'Hold on the steam, then she turns towards the street.', tagText: '', btnLabel: 'Remove from chain', btnKind: 'outline',\n        foot: 'START FRAME ARRIVES WHEN SHOT 1 FINISHES',\n        rule: 'Chained shots wait with empty slots on purpose — the start frame does not exist yet. Only the queue can be left.' },\n\n      { num: '08', title: 'Failed', shot: 'Shot 3', on: false, chain: 'CONTINUES FROM SHOT 2’S LAST FRAME',\n        status: 'FAILED', statusTint: '#8C2B0B', framesNote: 'FRAMES · 1 SET', slots: startOnly,\n        prompt: 'Pull back to the whole stall as the last customer leaves.', tagText: 'NOTHING WAS CHARGED', tagTint: 'bad',\n        btnLabel: 'Try again', btnKind: 'primary', footTint: '#8C2B0B',\n        foot: 'THE ENGINE RETURNED NOTHING · THE CHAIN STOPPED HERE',\n        rule: 'A failure keeps every input in place so the retry is one click. It also states where the chain stopped.' }\n    ];\n\n    return {\n      cards: set.map(c => this.build(c)),\n      notes: [\n        { tag: 'SHAPE NEVER MOVES', body: 'Header, frames row, three slots, prompt, action row. Every state uses the same eight rows so the eye can compare cards without re-reading them.' },\n        { tag: 'ONE STATUS WORD', body: 'Not ready, ready to render, queued, rendering, rendered, failed. Six words, one place — top right of the header, tinted but never bold.' },\n        { tag: 'BUTTON CARRIES THE STATE', body: 'Inert Generate when inputs are missing, filled Generate when ready, Cancel run mid-flight, outlined Regenerate once rendered, filled again the moment the prompt drifts.' },\n        { tag: 'TAGS ARE EXCEPTIONS', body: 'The area beside the button is empty in the ordinary states. It only fills for EDITED · NOT YET RUN and for a failure, so a tag always means something needs attention.' }\n      ]\n    };\n  }\n}\n<\u002Fscript>\n\n\n<\u002Fbody><\u002Fhtml>"
  </script>
</body>
</html>
